message.content: {"verdict":"HOLD","cited_clauses":[1,2,6],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"The payable amount cannot be confirmed from the agreement day rate because FACTS flags an arithmetic mismatch for the main line item.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"[ARITHMETIC_MISMATCH] Line \\\"Regression testing, releases 2.3 and 2.4\\\": 10 × 300 ≠ 3300.\""},{"clause":2,"finding":"Although the invoice line claims 10 days at 300 USDC/day (which would be within the 12-day monthly cap), the arithmetic mismatch means we cannot verify the correct capped amount to pay based on days worked and the day rate.","evidence_quote":"Invoice: \"Regression testing, releases 2.3 and 2.4    10 days × 300 = 3,300\""},{"clause":6,"finding":"Invoice receipt timing meets the 60-day requirement; timing is not the reason for holding—only the arithmetic mismatch is.","evidence_quote":"FACTS: \"Received 2026-09-05, 5 days after the billing period ended (2026-08-31).\""}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":false}
